text:
alex: kicking off plan for svc_user_profiles schema migration tonight. target quiesce window 02:00 UTC. asking for lock window 01:50-02:20 so we have buffer. release notes edited.

maya: ack. can we tighten to 02:00-02:15? ops prefers 15m quiesce.

alex: yeah we can do canary + short full window. deploy-bot scheduled details below.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: migration job svc_user_profiles.migrate_v2 -> 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z
  - holdpoint: preflight tests must pass
  - version_pin: app=2.3.1-db-migration-20260324
  - canary: az1 02:00-02:05, rollout 02:06-02:15

neha: preflight smoke ran on staging, minor warnings only. backfill will run async; recommend ratecap=50r/s. note: KV locking on hot partition could cause transient waits.

sam: add abort criteria: if lock wait > 5s for >3 hosts or DB p99 increases >200ms, trigger rollback. escape hatch: annotate deployment to force rollback: `kubectl annotate deploy svc-user rollback=true`

jorge: adding customer-facing blurb for release notes: "Schema update: user_profiles.last_active added (nullable)." also will pin consumer services to 2.3.1 for 24h post-migration. plan to canary EU region first.

alex: summary of ops plan: canary AZ1 02:00-02:05 (small shard), watch p99, lockwait, error rates. if good -> rollout 02:06-02:15. rollback on p99>200ms or lock wait >5s. who's oncall?

maya: i'm oncall that window and will watch DB-metrics + lockwatch.

deploy-bot: PRE-RUN CHECKLIST:
```
 - backup snapshot: required (scheduled 2026-03-24T01:45Z)
 - migration binary verified
 - preflight status: OK
 - canary window: set
 - rollback hook: enabled
```
To abort: `deploybot abort 1839991230`

neha: also gate schema flip behind feature-flag `user_profiles_new_schema` (off by default). flip only after backfill catches up.

sam: ops confirmed backup snapshot created at 01:45 UTC.

alex: perfect. i'll update the runbook with thresholds and pin the migration in the release notes. :thumbsup:

maya: ack. i'll post a short postmortem template in #postmortems in case we need it.

alex: thanks everyone — see you in the window.
